name: Dead or Alive 2

features.name: Three free spins modes
features.description: Old Saloon (sticky wilds), Train Heist (multipliers) and High Noon Saloon (wild multipliers) each have different volatility.

review: Dead or Alive 2 is the high-volatility classic that set the bar for western sticky-wild bonuses. The High Noon Saloon mode – sticky wilds with multipliers – is where the 111,111x cap lives. Very few spins pay well, but the bonuses are memorable.
